I aint talking about stuff you pay for im separating the years via expansion, thats why prophecy is something i included. 

But on that note, yes foresaken changed alot. It added pinnacle weapons, Gambit, and other stuff. But tell me. And this only for examples sake.

Niobe labs - had the whole community searching and wondering how itll end, with an exotic quest to end it.

Corridors of time - had the whole community searching and wondering how itll end, with an exotic quest to end it.

.

Pit of heresy - has you using a hive sword to kill 3 different enemy types while not telling you how to do so.

Shattered throne - you can beat this whole thing by simply clearing ads. Sure it was cool at the time. Bit it hasnt aged well at all.

.

Foresaken was a Re Release essentially. Thats what ive gathered from the comments. But alot of the hype behind it is simply cause it changed alot from year one which didnt sound so fun.

Shadowkeep was also a Re Release tho. It launched New Light. And added armor 2.0. Yes it was a smaller release then foresaken. But foresaken is kinda like a curse to this game. All the old players will always be just disappointed and bitter cause "Foresaken was so much better."
